commands.command: set -euo pipefail; adb start-server >/dev/null; echo '--- mdns ---'; adb mdns services || true; for E in $(adb mdns services 2>/dev/null | awk '/_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $NF}'); do adb connect "$E" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; sleep 2; echo '--- devices ---'; adb devices -l; SEL=''; for D in $(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); do case "$D" in *:*) M="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; if [ "$M" = SM-S906B ] && [ "$S" = RFCT70L7E8J ]; then SEL="$D"; break; fi;; esac; done; test -n "$SEL" || { echo 'verified_wireless_s22_not_found=true' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$SEL" >/tmp/aicall-wireless-selector; echo 'verified_wireless_s22=true'
